review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 preserve the specified live, read-only status getter, response reassignment behavior, compatibility, and compile-time assignment rejection. The exact writable scope covers the implementation, runtime regression tests, and proposed type test without requiring unrelated forwarding consumers or generated declarations to be edited. The supplied compiler configuration includes test-d, and the test script distinguishes compilation from AVA execution; the build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated artifacts. TASK-VERIFY remains independent and dependent on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with implementation and verification coverage required for every acceptance criterion. The supplied active trusted capability claims, delivery roles, membership eligibility, availability, and configured independent reviewer support the two assignment expectations and ready disposition; pending legacy claims and persona descriptions are not needed as evidence. No material unresolved Decision is present in this case, so the empty decision input and absence of decision blockers are consistent. Repository identity, commit, stable keys, and release-input fingerprints agree across the supplied records. The source fingerprint differences are explicitly explained by normalization and distinct digest domains. The original preparation snapshot's remaining items are resolved by the later supplied team facts and frozen release input, apart from this review. Isolation records state that Gold precedes every candidate and that no historical candidate outputs are supplied. This assessment uses the supplied Service-bound digest and provenance records; I did not independently recompute digests, execute code, or create a human attestation.
